content_zh:
随后，李然的脑海之中，开始涌出大量的模糊记忆片段。
这些记忆片段，在李然施展的灵魂修炼方法之中，变得无比的清晰，无比的深刻。
像是身临其境，像是亲身经历一样。
李然渐渐的开始融合姜辰遇害之前的坎坷记忆。
随着记忆的融合，李然也如重新历经了一次完整的人生一般。
那个姜辰，婴儿的时候被一个浑身黑袍的男子抛弃到一片漆黑色的海洋之中，身边，唯有一部《天河剑诀》为伴。
数天之后，姜辰被一对名为‘姜苍云’和‘风彩依’的年轻夫妇救起，带回姜家抚养。接着姜苍云和风彩依，因为一件诡异的事情离开家门。其后，风彩依失踪，姜苍云重创归来，失去了大部分修为，却带回了他的女儿姜宁儿。
再之后，姜辰与妹|妹姜宁儿相依为命，共同照顾姜苍云，也无比努力的修炼。
后来，姜宁儿被万雪宫的太长老看中，进|入万雪宫苦修。
而姜辰，也被天剑宗选中，进|入了天剑宗。在天剑宗中，姜辰迷恋上了林家的天之骄女、天剑宗的十大仙子之一的林雪瑶。姜辰不听父亲和妹|妹的劝阻，色迷心窍，被林雪瑶一次又一次利用，骗走了他拥有的所有修炼资源。
之后，在姜辰大婚之日，林雪瑶骗走了与他的身份来历密切相关的《天河剑诀》，接着姜辰被天剑宗的天才弟子聂延废除修为、毁尽武脉，并为此搭上了养父姜苍云的性命。
最终，姜辰被逐出家族，成为姜家的最大耻辱和沧澜城的笑话。
其实，在姜辰被逐出家族的当晚，他就死了。
不过因为李然莫名的穿越过来，所以姜辰又活了。
或者说，是李然活了，可惜被姜辰的灵魂一直压制着，无比憋屈而无奈的苟活了三年。
李然恍若身临其境一样，又仿佛亲身参与了这一次的人生，因而，在记忆融合完毕之后，李然心中感慨万千，唏嘘不已。
原本，李然是根本不会在意姜辰的，但，姜辰最终的放手，让李然深受触动，三年来的怨忿和不满，也就消散了。
哪怕是姜辰什么都很糟糕，但他对于姜宁儿的守护，却值得尊重。
而也因为姜宁儿，李然选择了与姜辰灵魂融合，姜辰却选择了自我牺牲，成就李然。
“生亦何欢，死亦何哀。今后，我李然，就是姜辰了！”

李然，也就是如今的姜辰，目光变得无比坚定。
也是在这一刻，姜辰感觉，自己的灵魂，竟是变得无比的灼|热了起来。
似乎，灵魂，都在开始发光。
“怎么回事？！”
姜辰也有些吃惊。
但随即，他的灵魂能量荡漾了出去，因而立刻感觉到，在外面，他干枯破损的身|体竟是开始急速的恢复了起来。
体|内破损的经脉，那破碎的丹田，也都在快速的复原着。
那原本打入头部伤口之中的三重造化丹，如今已全部的被炼化，并伴随着一片鲜艳的血水，一起融入他的身|体之中，为他提供生生不息的生命能量。
姜宁儿，竟是以自己|胸|口的心血，结合三重造化丹，强行为姜辰恢复！
姜辰的心，狠狠的一震！
随即，他的灵魂剧烈的震荡着。
他不是过去的姜辰，岂能如此无动于衷的承受这种付出！
姜辰的灵魂，如再次的加了一把火，彻底疯|狂的燃烧了起来。
这其中，或许承载着的，是沉寂了三年的两道灵魂的怒吼、狂暴！
那一刻，他的身|体，陡然变得通红，强大的灵魂力量漫延而出，极快的恢复起身|体里的各种损伤！
那一刻，他的身|体，一片热，殷红得如要烧起来一样。
他的头顶，伤口极速愈合，同时开始冒出大片的白|色雾气。
姜辰如今可以控制自己的身|体，但是却无法清醒过来，似乎，因为灵魂的变化，虽然与身|体无比契合，但灵魂如被压迫住了一样，无法苏醒肉身。
姜辰的灵魂膨胀了起来，身|体更加火|热。他的魂力漫延而出，强行的要掌控自己的身|体。
只是，此时，便是动一下手指，似乎都如撼动一座大山一样艰难。

可，姜辰意志极为坚定，庞大的灵魂力量，在如此执念之中，如山洪暴发。
“轰！”
灵魂如炸开一样，姜辰感觉七彩雷光漫延四方，漆黑的灵魂空间陡然变得一片血雾弥漫，血雾之中，七彩雷光肆虐无尽。

content_en:
Then, a large number of vague memory fragments began to pour out of Li Ran's mind.
These memory fragments became extremely clear and profound in the soul cultivation method used by Li Ran.
It's like being there, experiencing it personally.
Li Ran gradually began to integrate Jiang Chen's rough memories before his murder.
With the fusion of memories, Li Ran felt as if he had experienced a complete life again.
That Jiang Chen was abandoned by a man in black robes into a pitch-black ocean when he was a baby, with only the "Tianhe Sword Art" as his companion.
A few days later, Jiang Chen was rescued by a young couple named 'Jiang Cangyun' and 'Feng Caiyi', and was brought back to the Jiang family to be raised. Then Jiang Cangyun and Feng Caiyi left home because of a strange thing. Afterwards, Feng Caiyi disappeared, and Jiang Cangyun came back severely injured and lost most of his cultivation, but he brought back his daughter Jiang Ning'er.
After that, Jiang Chen and his younger sister Jiang Ning'er depended on each other, taking care of Jiang Cangyun together and practicing extremely hard.
Later, Jiang Ning'er was spotted by the Grand Elder of Wanxue Palace and entered the Wanxue Palace to practice hard.
And Jiang Chen was also selected by the Tianjian Sect and entered the Tianjian Sect. In the Tianjian Sect, Jiang Chen fell in love with Lin Xueyao, the proud daughter of the Lin family and one of the top ten fairies of the Tianjian Sect. Jiang Chen did not listen to the dissuasion of his father and sister, and became obsessed with sex. He was used by Lin Xueyao time and time again to defraud him of all the cultivation resources he had.
Later, on Jiang Chen's wedding day, Lin Xueyao defrauded him of the "Tianhe Sword Art", which was closely related to his identity. Then Jiang Chen was deprived of his cultivation and martial arts by Nie Yan, a genius disciple of the Tianjian Sect, and his adoptive father Jiang Cangyun was killed for this.
In the end, Jiang Chen was expelled from the family and became the biggest shame of the Jiang family and the joke of Canglan City.
In fact, Jiang Chen died on the night he was expelled from the family.
However, because Li Ran traveled through time inexplicably, Jiang Chen was alive again.
In other words, Li Ran survived, but unfortunately he was suppressed by Jiang Chen's soul, and he lived for three years in an extremely aggrieved and helpless way.
Li Ran felt as if he was immersed in the scene, and seemed to have personally participated in this life. Therefore, after the memory was integrated, Li Ran felt filled with emotion and lamentation.
Originally, Li Ran didn't care about Jiang Chen at all, but when Jiang Chen finally let go, Li Ran was deeply touched, and the resentment and dissatisfaction of the past three years dissipated.
Even though Jiang Chen was terrible at everything, his protection of Jiang Ning'er was worthy of respect.
And because of Jiang Ning'er, Li Ran chose to merge with Jiang Chen's soul, but Jiang Chen chose to sacrifice himself to achieve Li Ran's success.
"There is no joy in life, no sorrow in death. From now on, I, Li Ran, will be Jiang Chen!"
Li Ran, now Jiang Chen, his eyes became extremely firm.
It was also at this moment that Jiang Chen felt that his soul had become extremely hot.
It seems that the soul is starting to shine.
"What's going on?!"
Jiang Chen was also a little surprised.
But immediately, his soul energy rippled out, and he immediately felt that outside, his dry and damaged body began to recover rapidly.
The damaged meridians in the body and the broken Dantian are also recovering quickly.
The triple creation pill that was originally injected into the head wound has now been completely refined, and along with a piece of bright blood, it has been integrated into his body, providing him with endless life energy.
Jiang Ning'er actually used her own hard work and combined with the triple creation pill to forcefully restore Jiang Chen!
Jiang Chen's heart was severely shaken!
Immediately, his soul shook violently.
He was not the Jiang Chen of the past, how could he bear such sacrifices so indifferently!
Jiang Chen's soul, as if a fire was added again, burned completely crazily.
Perhaps it carries something that has been silent for three years.The roar and rage of two souls!
At that moment, his body suddenly turned red, and powerful soul power spread out, recovering all kinds of injuries in his body very quickly!
At that moment, his body was so hot that it felt as if it was about to burn.
On the top of his head, the wound healed rapidly, and at the same time large amounts of white mist began to emerge.
Jiang Chen can now control his body, but he cannot wake up. It seems that because of the changes in his soul, although it is incomparable with his body, the soul seems to be oppressed and cannot wake up the body.
Jiang Chen's soul expanded, and his body became even hotter. His soul power spread out, forcing himself to control his body.
However, at this time, even moving a finger seems to be as difficult as shaking a mountain.
However, Jiang Chen's will is extremely firm, and his huge soul power is like a flash flood amid such obsession.
"Boom!"
As if his soul was exploding, Jiang Chen felt the colorful lightning spreading in all directions, and the dark soul space suddenly became filled with blood mist. In the blood mist, the colorful lightning raged endlessly.
